https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Up 28% in a week, far more than the market, with the slab at only 1.14x raw
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: Pikachu VMAX CSR sales rose from ¥29.6k (9/28) to ¥37-38k now, and the lowest ask is ¥37,980. That is +28% in 7 days against +5.7% for the My-tier index. Trading doubled to about 3 sales a day. Raw A fell to ¥18k (from ¥20k).

Why: Not explained by news: I found no reprint or new product for this card. Part of it is a rebound from a thin, cheap start (the book had only a few cheap listings), and the raw price is still falling. The slab premium reading (1.14x vs a 2.31x norm) is from pokeca-chart's last point on 9/21, so it is stale.

For you: The ask is above Buy (¥31k) and just above the ¥37k ceiling, and your ¥29k limit is far away. Chasing this move is the pattern the correction rule is meant to stop.

Watch: Whether sales hold ¥36k+ over the next checks or slip back toward ¥31k, and whether raw A keeps falling, which would lower the cost of self-grading.
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.signals: 7d price +28.3% (¥29,600→¥37,980) vs My-tier index +5.7% = +22.6 pts; PSA10 sales/day 2.9 vs 1.5; slab premium 1.14x vs 6-month norm 2.31x
